item.title: MDARD announces water infrastructure grant opportunities for Michigan county fairs
item.description: Even in March, it's not too early for organizations to plan for their next county fair. The Michigan Department of Agriculture and Rural Development is assisting in those preparations, with a new grant opportunity to help with fairgrounds and their water systems.

item.title: Delta County snow removal efforts continue
item.description: "We understand the anxiety, stress and frustration the public is feeling right now, but we ask that you please try to remain patient and try to be kind to the people answering the phone calls that do not stop," the County Road Commission wrote on social media. "We will do our best to try and help in any way we can."

item.title: Sen. Mullin Faces Confirmation Hearing Amid DHS Shutdown
item.description: WASHINGTON, D.C. - Oklahoma Senator Markwayne Mullin was in the hot seat Wednesday morning, answering questions from his fellow Senate colleagues after the President tapped him to be the next Homeland Security Secretary. In a three-hour long hearing, Senator Mullin tries to make the case for why he should be confirmed as the next DHS Secretary.

item.title: Michigan Democrats, Republicans clash as Vance visits state
item.description: Vice President JD Vance said rising gas prices tied to the Iran conflict are temporary during a visit to Michigan. Democrats argue the administration’s policies are increasing costs and hurting families.
